name: context-engineering-kit
description: Automated context preservation for Claude Code, Cursor, Grok, and Codex across sessions, devices, worktrees, and subscriptions. Hooks execute real handovers at usage thresholds; multi-runtime adapters share one logic core.

interface.shortDescription: Session handover, token tracking, and cross-device context sync
interface.longDescription: Keeps CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, and session_handover.md current across sessions, devices, and runtimes. Lifecycle hooks write a real handover at usage thresholds and at session end, so a new session resumes exactly where the last one stopped.
